project.name: harness :: protocol (frozen contracts)
project.description: Wire-level contracts shared by the platform, the edge layer and the terminal agent: UUIDv7 ids, the TCP frame codec (03 §3.2), the command code table (03 §3.3), capability tokens (03 §5) and the event envelope (03 §4). Deliberately dependency-free so it can be embedded in the terminal runtime as-is.
